metadata.name: nanoclaw-repl
metadata.description: Operate and extend NanoClaw, ECC's zero-dependency session-aware REPL, with persistent markdown-backed sessions and slash commands for model switching, skill loading, session branching, cross-session search, history compaction, and export. Use when running or extending scripts/claw.js, or when resuming, branching, compacting, searching, or exporting a NanoClaw session.
